page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-4x.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the server is equipped with four NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, offering a combined VRAM capacity of 288 GB. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 128 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, this server represents a high-end hardware class optimized for parallel processing. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for external storage solutions, which represents a tradeoff in local I/O speed but allows for flexible storage scaling. The high density of GPU memory and dedicated vCPUs offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive parallel computation without the overhead of maintaining physical hardware.

This hardware profile is suited for large-scale artificial intelligence workloads, including deep learning model training, large language model inference, high-performance computing, and complex data science simulations.
